name: Question 2
problem:
Consider the straight line with the parametric equations

$$
{\begin{aligned}x=1-2t \\ y=5-t \\ z=-7+t\end{aligned}
$$

for $t\in (-\infty ,\infty ).$ Find the Cartesian equation of this line.

Question 2
?

Consider the straight line with the parametric equations {x=1−2ty=5−tz=−7+t for t∈(−∞,∞). Find the Cartesian equation of this line.

a
x+1−2=y−5−1=z−71
b
x−1−2=y−5−1=z+71
c
x−21=y+1−5=z−1−7
d
x+21=y+15=z−1−7
e
x+2−1=y−5−1=z+71
Submit
